import sys
from collections import defaultdict

def dfs(node, parent, visited, disc, low, ap, graph):
    global time
    children = 0
    visited[node] = True
    disc[node] = low[node] = time
    time += 1
    for neighbor in graph[node]:
        if not visited[neighbor]:
            children += 1
            dfs(neighbor, node, visited, disc, low, ap, graph)
            low[node] = min(low[node], low[neighbor])
            if parent != -1 and low[neighbor] >= disc[node]:
                ap[node] = True
        elif neighbor != parent:
            low[node] = min(low[node], disc[neighbor])
    if parent == -1 and children > 1:
        ap[node] = True

def doctorStrange(N, M, graph):
    visited = [False] * (N + 1)
    disc = [float("Inf")] * (N + 1)
    low = [float("Inf")] * (N + 1)
    ap = [False] * (N + 1)
    global time
    time = 0
    for i in range(1, N + 1):
        if not visited[i]:
            dfs(i, -1, visited, disc, low, ap, graph)
    return sum(ap)

input = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
N = int(input[0])
M = int(input[1])
graph = defaultdict(list)
index = 2
for _ in range(M):
    u = int(input[index])
    v = int(input[index + 1])
    graph[u].append(v)
    graph[v].append(u)
    index += 2
print(doctorStrange(N, M, graph))
